description:
A lightweight desktop AI client and screen-level agent: chat, tools, translation, OCR, and visual Q&A in one small app.

Kivio is a compact desktop AI client with a built-in agent runtime. It stays in the tray or menu bar, opens when you need it, and keeps a much smaller footprint than a browser-based AI workspace.
- Kivio Agent — chat, projects, assistants, memory, file/image attachments, MCP, Skills, and native tools (file ops, shell, web fetch/search, Pyodide run_python).
- Lens — screenshot-based visual Q&A, OCR, formula extraction, text polishing, and optional web-aware answers.
- Fast translation — typed text, selected text, windows, and arbitrary screen regions.
- Bring your own models — OpenAI-compatible providers and Anthropic Messages, with per-feature model routing and multi-key failover.
- Document-ready — PDF / Word / Excel workflows run on a bundled offline Pyodide sandbox, no first-run CDN download required.
- Private by default — no telemetry; API keys and conversation data stay on your machine.
Kivio Desktop v3.1.4
桌面 AI 助手 · macOS (Apple Silicon) + Windows。Desktop AI assistant for macOS (Apple Silicon) and Windows.
下载 / Downloads
- Windows 安装包 / Installer — Kivio.Desktop_3.1.4_x64-setup.exe（NSIS）
- Windows 便携版 / Portable — Kivio.Desktop_3.1.4_x64-portable.zip，解压后运行 Kivio Desktop.exe / unzip and run.
  - 需要 Edge WebView2，设置和对话与安装版共用。Requires Edge WebView2; settings and conversations are shared with the installed app.
  - 应用内更新仍下载安装包；继续使用便携版请手动下载新 ZIP。In-app updates download the NSIS installer; download the new ZIP manually to remain portable.
- macOS — Kivio.Desktop_3.1.4_aarch64.dmg（Apple Silicon，未签名 / unsigned）
  - 首次启动：右键 → 打开，或运行 xattr -cr "/Applications/Kivio Desktop.app"。
  - First launch: right-click → Open, or run the command above.
新版本亮点 / What's New
以下是 v3.1.3 → v3.1.4 的变更。These changes cover v3.1.3 → v3.1.4.
- WebDAV 备份 / WebDAV backups — 新增手动上传配置或完整备份、查看远程备份、恢复和删除；提供连接测试与服务配置提示，并改善目录、文件列表及错误处理兼容性。Add manual configuration and full backups over WebDAV, with remote listing, restore, deletion, connection testing, service setup guidance, and improved compatibility handling.
- 运行中补充消息 / Messages during a running turn — 优先将新消息直接交给当前运行处理；不支持或未受理时保留到轮末发送，并修正输入框及消息展示状态。Prefer delivering new messages to the active run, retain unsupported or rejected messages for follow-up, and correct composer and message presentation states.
- 停止回复 / Stopping responses — 停止时保留已经生成的内容，减少额外停止提示，并修正流式预览与历史显示。Preserve generated content when stopping, reduce redundant stop notices, and correct streaming previews and history rendering.
- 加载响应 / Loading responsiveness — 将多处文件读取、解析和扫描移出 UI 线程，改善笔记、技能、插件、知识库及用量页面的加载响应。Move file reads, parsing, and scans off the UI thread across notes, skills, plugins, knowledge bases, and usage views.
- 模型与兼容修复 / Model and compatibility fixes — 更新模型价格与推理档位资料，修复桌面端 MCP 注册表请求限制，并调整深色侧栏、加载背景与按钮悬停样式。Update model pricing and reasoning metadata, allow desktop MCP registry requests, and refine dark sidebar materials, loading backgrounds, and button hover styles.
完整变更 / Full changelog: https://github.com/ZMGID/kivio/compare/v3.1.3...v3.1.4
